$comment: Front-end size budgets, checked by scripts/size-budget.mjs against a production build (`pnpm --filter @recx/web build && pnpm --filter @recx/web size`). Sizes are gzip level 9; 1 KB = 1,024 bytes. App Router routes (`entry`): first-load JS = Next's rootMainFiles + every client chunk of the route's layout chain (layouts, templates, error/loading/not-found boundaries, global-error) + the page. Pages Router routes (`page`): the scripts the SERVED HTML loads (the build is served in-process and the page fetched signed out); `zeroJs` additionally requires no <script src>, no script preload, no __NEXT_DATA__ and a compiled unstable_runtimeJS: false. A route with `shared: false` is budgeted but left out of the shared first-party measure. Measured numbers and their history: docs/CAPACITY.md, 'Front-end budgets'.

routes.$comment: Phase 8a. A form and a list, and it must stay that: this is the page somebody opens on a phone from a hospital bed, and from Phase 8e it is part of the route out of an inactivity restriction.
Phase 8e. The route OUT of an inactivity restriction: one button and two lists. It must stay small, because the student who needs it most is the one on the worst connection.

Phase 9c. Readiness: three cards, a component table each and no interactivity at all. It is in serverRendered below, so this budget is the layout chain plus nothing — a client component added here fails both checks.

zeroJsSelfCheck.$comment: A public App Router page served alongside the zero-JS routes: it MUST show script tags, or the HTML detector has gone blind.

sharedFirstParty.$comment: First-party code (apps/web/src, packages/*) in the chunks that two or more budgeted routes load (design system, shells, shared libraries). A chunk that mixes first- and third-party modules counts in proportion to its first-party source bytes.

monaco.$comment: The Monaco chunk of the spec ('<= 1,050 KB lazy'): the main-thread code the editor fetches from /monaco/vs on a cold workspace load — the AMD loader, the editor core and one tokenizer grammar (the largest offered, so any language fits). The editor web worker is a separate worker script, not part of this chunk; it has its own line (monacoWorker). CSS and the codicon font are reported, not budgeted (not JS). Decision: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md, Phase 3, 'Front-end budgets'.

monacoWorker.$comment: The generic editor worker (the only Monaco worker shipped: no TS/JSON/CSS/HTML language services), started by the editor after it mounts. Budgeted on its own so it stays measured.

codemirror.$comment: The phone editor (< 768 px): the lazy CodeMirror 6 chunk set plus its largest language grammar.

monacoFree.$comment: No Monaco module (the monaco-editor package or the editor's own Monaco loader/controller/theme) may appear in these routes' chunk graphs, first-load or lazy.

serverRendered.$comment: Pages that add no client JS of their own: the page's chunks beyond the framework and its layout chain may hold only Next's page stub (one module named exactly "apps/web"), at most maxOwnKb gzip. Any first-party or third-party client module there is a failure.
